subject: Robust goodness of fit not showing in v06-18 ?

messages.author: 551325a810f0e047
messages.subject: Robust goodness of fit not showing in v06-18 ?
parts:
Sorry in advance if this is my mistake. 

Under lavaan 0.6-17 I do get robust CFI, TLI, RMSEA, but running the exact same under 0.6-18 gives 'NA'. All data in my model are ordinal. 

Don't know if this is a bug, or if the robust values under v0.6-17 are problematic? 

In case relevant this is the model: 

# Fit model > fit_two_factor <- cfa( + model = two_factor, + data = raw.data, + rotation = "oblimin", + estimator = "WLSMV", + ordered = TRUE + )

I've gone back to 0.6-17 because these robust indicators are important for my study, so no crisis here - but i wanted to share what i'd noticed.
